name: Equilibria transferable-share reward replay
summary: VaultEPendle did not update reward debt on share transfers and public getReward(account) let fresh receivers re-claim the same native rewards repeatedly.
notes: Five successful reward-replay transactions plus one funding-only attempt form one episode. CALL-value outflows minus all campaign inflows, including recycled payouts and the standalone 0.664440216358314284 ETH topup, equal 13.599119865909616611 ETH. This matches vault balance depletion from 13.603353927190515249 to 0.004234061280898638 ETH over blocks 23203451–23204165. Net loss is used because pooled attacker inputs cannot be assigned individually to the residual balance. Gas, builder payments and later recoveries are not deductions. All ETH is valued at the first-exploit historical price; the campaign lasts under three hours.
